Let’s figure it out.

You work directly with me. Bring the problem or the idea; you don’t need to know the technical terms.

  1. 01

    Tell me what’s up.

    A few details, a website link, or a device model gives us a place to start.

  2. 02

    Agree on the work.

    We’ll talk through the approach, cost, and timing before getting started.

  3. 03

    Put it to use.

    We’ll walk through the result and your questions about using it.

Before you write

Fair questions.

What will it cost?

Every project starts a little differently. Send me a few details about what you need, and we can talk through the scope and a quote before work begins.

Can you fix my particular phone or computer?

That depends on the model, the problem, and the parts needed. Send the device model and describe what’s happening, including any damage or error messages. I’ll help you work out the options.

Where do I bring a device?

Contact me first so we can discuss the issue and arrange a handoff. Fremont Digital is based in Fremont County, Wyoming; there isn’t a public storefront at this time.

My project doesn’t fit neatly into a category.

That’s fine. If it involves a computer, a website, photography, video, or getting technology to cooperate, tell me about it. I’ll be straight with you about whether I can help.
